title: Stir Fried Fish with Portuguese Spices
description: A fusion dish that combines the bold flavors of Portugal with the quick stir-fry techniques of China. This recipe is a great way to add some excitement to your meal.

ingredients.name: fish (cut into bite-sized pieces)
ingredients.notes: Any white fish works well, such as cod or tilapia

ingredients.name: unique portuguese chili peppers
ingredients.notes: Also known as piri piri peppers

ingredients.name: savory soy sauce
ingredients.notes: You can adjust the amount to taste

ingredients.name: portuguese olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a good quality oil for the best flavor

ingredients.name: chinese broccoli
ingredients.notes: You can use regular broccoli as a substitute if needed

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher or sea salt for the best flavor

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the fish to the wok and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until it's cooked through.
Remove the fish from the wok and set it aside.
Add the chili peppers to the wok and cook for 1 minute, until they start to soften.
Add the broccoli to the wok and cook for 2-3 minutes, until it's tender.
Add the garlic and ginger to the wok and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the soy sauce to the wok and stir to combine.
Return the fish to the wok and stir to combine with the sauce.
Optional: Serve with steamed rice or noodles for a filling meal.
